sub_question: SQ-2: DESTINY-Breast ferroptosis-consistent AEs + SLC7A11 translational sub-studies

primary_finding.citation: Hua Y, Duan N et al. eLife 2025 Jun 4;14:RP103953
primary_finding.title: Targeting SLC7A11-mediated cysteine metabolism for the treatment of trastuzumab-resistant HER2-positive breast cancer
primary_finding.key_result: SLC7A11 is epigenetically upregulated (H3K4me3 gain + DNA hypomethylation) as a primary trastuzumab resistance mechanism in HER2+ BC. SLC7A11 inhibition + cysteine starvation + trastuzumab synergistically induces ferroptosis in trastuzumab-resistant cells.
primary_finding.significance: LANDMARK — directly links SLC7A11 to trastuzumab resistance in HER2+ BC. Establishes that SLC7A11-high HER2+ tumors are trastuzumab-resistant. The novel T-DXd hypothesis now has mechanistic grounding: T-DXd may exploit the SLC7A11-high state that tumors acquired during trastuzumab resistance.

secondary_findings.citation: Xu J et al. Nat Cancer 2026 Feb;7(2):334-351
secondary_findings.title: Targeted inhibition of FBXL2 confers susceptibility of HER2-negative breast cancer to trastuzumab deruxtecan
secondary_findings.key_result: FBXL2 loss → breast cancer stemness (CD44high/CD24low) → T-DXd resistance in HER2-neg BC. Parallel but distinct from ferroptosis axis.
secondary_findings.significance: Establishes that T-DXd resistance has multiple parallel mechanisms; stemness is one. Ferroptosis/SLC7A11 is a separate axis. FBXL2-CD44high-SLC7A11 may converge (CD44v stabilizes xCT/SLC7A11, PMID 26930718).

secondary_findings.citation: Hasegawa M et al. Oncotarget 2016 Mar;7(11):11756-69
secondary_findings.title: Functional interactions of cystine/glutamate antiporter, CD44v and MUC1-C in triple-negative breast cancer cells
secondary_findings.key_result: CD44v directly stabilizes xCT/SLC7A11 in the cell membrane. MUC1-C binds CD44v and further protects against erastin/ferroptosis. CD44high state → xCT/SLC7A11 stability → ferroptosis resistance.
secondary_findings.significance: Mechanistically connects FBXL2→CD44high (Nat Cancer 2026) → SLC7A11 stability axis. Suggests stemness and ferroptosis resistance are structurally linked via CD44v-xCT complex.

secondary_findings.citation: Reddy DR et al. Biomed Pharmacother 2026 Mar;196:119113
secondary_findings.title: CD44v9 as a therapeutic target for antibody-drug conjugate in advanced breast cancer
secondary_findings.key_result: CD44v9 proposed as novel ADC target in breast cancer beyond HER2. CD44v9 co-expression with SLC7A11 is implicit in the targeting rationale.
secondary_findings.significance: Validates CD44v9-xCT co-targeting concept in breast ADC space — convergent with our hypothesis.

gap_findings.slc7a11_destiny_breast: ZERO published DESTINY-Breast translational sub-studies measuring SLC7A11, NRF2, or xCT. Gap confirmed across DB-01 through DB-08.
gap_findings.ferroptosis_ae_signature: No ferroptosis-consistent AE pattern in T-DXd clinical safety literature. Safety reviews (PMID 41785741) focus on ILD, thrombocytopenia, nausea, cardiotoxicity. Iron dyshomeostasis or lipid peroxidation not reported as T-DXd signature AE.
gap_findings.tdxd_slc7a11_direct: Zero papers directly testing T-DXd or DXd payload against SLC7A11/ferroptosis in any cancer type. Gap confirmed — same as HER2-EXP-001.
gap_findings.clinical_trials: 8 completed T-DXd trials found via ClinicalTrials.gov. None include SLC7A11 IHC, xCT expression, or ferroptosis biomarkers in their registered outcome measures.

hypothesis_refinement.original_claim: T-DXd co-activates ferroptosis via DXd payload in HER2+ BC; SLC7A11-high tumors escape.
hypothesis_refinement.refined_claim_v4: Trastuzumab resistance in HER2+ BC epigenetically upregulates SLC7A11 (H3K4me3/DNA hypomethylation, PMID 40464376), creating a ferroptosis dependency exploitable by T-DXd's DXd payload. T-DXd specifically overcomes trastuzumab resistance by exploiting the SLC7A11-high escape mechanism tumors already acquired. The FBXL2-CD44high-SLC7A11 axis (Nat Cancer 2026 + Oncotarget 2016) provides a parallel stemness-ferroptosis resistance integration point. SLC7A11 IHC H-score is the predicted predictive biomarker for T-DXd ferroptosis efficacy in trastuzumab-pretreated HER2+ BC.
hypothesis_refinement.clinical_implication: Patient selection: T-DXd most effective in trastuzumab-resistant SLC7A11-high HER2+ BC. Standard T-DXd sequencing (post-trastuzumab) may already enrich for SLC7A11-high tumors — retrospective IHC from DESTINY-Breast tumor banks would be immediately actionable.

mechanistic_plausibility.reason: PMID 40464376 directly establishes SLC7A11 upregulation in trastuzumab-resistant HER2+ BC — mechanistic chain shortened

evidential_quality.reason: T-DXd+ferroptosis still inferential but now has first-degree mechanistic anchor in HER2+ BC

gap_score.reason: T-DXd+SLC7A11 as predictive biomarker still completely absent from literature

novelty.reason: Refined framing (T-DXd exploiting trastuzumab-resistance-acquired SLC7A11) is clinically novel and actionable

next_node_priority: HIGH — NRF2-SLC7A11 PI3K axis under trastuzumab now has PMID 40464376 as anchor; need to determine if DXd payload independently suppresses NRF2 or if antibody component handles it
